messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (about 0.1 atm), the freezing point of pure water drops slightly below the normal 0 °C.  
A commonly cited value is:

**≈ –2.2 °C**

This is an approximate figure; the exact value can vary slightly depending on the source and the precision of the phase‑diagram data used.
